headline: OZ VISION INC. said previously issued financial statements should no longer be relied upon
label: Restatement

evidence.stated_reason: IWAC Holding Company Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “Company”), is unable to file its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended September 30, 2026 (the “September Form 10-Q”) by the prescribed due date. The Company has not yet filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the fiscal quarter ended June 30, 2026 (the “June Form 10-Q”), and the financial statements for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 cannot be completed until the June Form 10-Q is finalized. The Company intends to file the June Form 10-Q and the September Form 10-Q as soon as practicable.
